prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_hits_total
prometheus_families.help: Fresh L1 cache hits served.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_misses_total
prometheus_families.help: Misses that went to the origin.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_stale_serves_total
prometheus_families.help: Stale copies served while a refresh ran.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_refreshes_total
prometheus_families.help: Background single-flight refreshes started.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_evictions_total
prometheus_families.help: Entries evicted under memory pressure (LRU).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_l2_hits_total
prometheus_families.help: L1 misses satisfied by the L2 tier (Redis or memcached).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_l2_misses_total
prometheus_families.help: L1 misses that L2 could not satisfy (went to origin).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_lock_waits_total
prometheus_families.help: Cold-miss requests that waited for a single-flight fill (v10).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_min_uses_skips_total
prometheus_families.help: Cold misses sent to origin without storing because the key is below cache_turbo_min_uses (v15).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_l2_neg_skips_total
prometheus_families.help: L2 GETs skipped because a negative memo already recorded a miss for the key (L13).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_bypasses_total
prometheus_families.help: Requests skipped straight to origin by a cache_turbo_bypass predicate or a CMS backend preset (subset of misses).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_refuse_set_cookie_total
prometheus_families.help: Store refused because the response carried a Set-Cookie header.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_refuse_encoded_total
prometheus_families.help: Store refused because the response was already Content-Encoding'd (origin pre-compression or filter mis-order).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_refuse_vary_unsafe_total
prometheus_families.help: Store refused: Vary named an axis outside the whitelist or "*".

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_refuse_authorization_total
prometheus_families.help: Store refused because the request carried Authorization.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_refuse_cache_control_total
prometheus_families.help: Store refused by a Cache-Control (or CDN-/Surrogate-) no-store/no-cache/private/max-age=0 directive.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_refuse_require_header_total
prometheus_families.help: Store refused because cache_turbo_require_header was unmet (absent or not affirmative).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_refuse_partial_total
prometheus_families.help: Store refused because the response was 206 Partial Content.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_refuse_head_total
prometheus_families.help: Store refused because the request was HEAD.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_regen_cost_ms
prometheus_families.help: Average origin regeneration cost in milliseconds.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_autotuned_beta
prometheus_families.help: Live autotuned SWR beta (x1000; 0 = none).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_autotuned_load
prometheus_families.help: Live load factor widening stale window + lock_ttl under load (x1000; 1000 = none).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_sie_serves_total
prometheus_families.help: Responses served from a stale-if-error snapshot.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_breaker_serves_total
prometheus_families.help: Responses served from the circuit breaker's armed fallback while OPEN.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_origin_failures_total
prometheus_families.help: Origin responses recorded as a failure by the circuit breaker.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_varidx_drops_total
prometheus_families.help: Auto-Vary variant-index writes dropped before reaching the transport at store time (self-heals on the next hit).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_tag_index_drops_total
prometheus_families.help: Purge-by-tag index writes dropped before reaching the transport at store time (no self-heal; a later purge of the tag will not invalidate the affected object until its own TTL).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_tag_cap_drops_total
prometheus_families.help: Tags silently dropped from the purge-by-tag index because a response named more than NGX_HTTP_CACHE_TURBO_MAX_TAGS distinct tags (no self-heal; a later purge of a dropped tag will not invalidate the affected object until its own TTL).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_breaker_opens_total
prometheus_families.help: Lifetime count of CLOSED->OPEN circuit breaker trips.

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_breaker_state
prometheus_families.help: Circuit breaker state (0=closed, 1=open, 2=half-open).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_bg_inflight
prometheus_families.help: Background-refresh subrequests currently in flight for this zone (cache_turbo_background_update_max cap).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_sketch_gen
prometheus_families.help: W-TinyLFU sketch aging generation (full incremental halving laps completed so far; 0 = never aged or no sketch).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_sketch_bumps_total
prometheus_families.help: Lifetime W-TinyLFU sketch increments (0 on a live zone means the sketch was never allocated).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_admission_refused_total
prometheus_families.help: New entries refused by W-TinyLFU admission control (cache_turbo_zone ... admission=on).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_used_bytes
prometheus_families.help: Slab bytes currently charged for cached payload and metadata in this zone (excludes fixed per-zone init overhead).

prometheus_families.name: cache_turbo_markers
prometheus_families.help: Live count of L1 auto-Vary marker nodes resident in this zone (0 gates the vary-marker probe off, C3).
